# Plan and build — first existing-code journey

Continues Patrick's existing eight-task draft after the authorized Spec handoff
repair and closeout. This is the sole executable ladder for docs/specs/plan-build/.
First fixture and exact authority/effect boundaries: docs/specs/plan-build/first-journey.md.

The instruction to proceed is retained in decisions.md D7. Task results still
require their existing acceptance decisions. Live activation, release and Attune
AI retirement remain outside this plan's authorization. Native allocations need
their separate concrete decisions.

Tasks 1–7 are accepted. Patrick approved Task 8's bounded 24-call comparison;
it completed at 59.83688 estimated Codex credits and failed the native outcome
floor. The contract correction and separately approved 12-call confirmation are complete.
All 12 replies passed the response contract; Luna and Astra each passed four
cases. One Fable worker fails the CLI oracle and one plan needs a minor factual
qualification. The confirmation used 30.29318 estimated Codex credits. Task 8
remains open. The approved connected comparison used ten calls and 66.959635
estimated credits. Review controls pass 4/4, but the original journeys stop at a
missing planner field and a test-runner import defect. Six calls remain unused;
this allocation is closed. See docs/plan-build-connected-results.md.
The handoff correction is locally qualified (267 source, 267 installed checks;
4/4 guard removals detected). Patrick's separate 40-credit confirmation stopped
after four calls and 7.744460 estimated credits on a default-output regression
missed by the original protected oracle. Two calls remain unused; the allocation
is closed. The local captured-output correction passes 38 source and 38 installed
checks, 1/1 guard-removal detection and the retained-reply connected replay.
Task 8 remains unaccepted. See docs/plan-build-handoff-confirmation-results.md
and docs/plan-build-default-compatibility-results.md.
Patrick then authorized 40 additional credits for a fresh complete journey.
It used five calls and 4.701455 estimated credits: planning/exporter/CLI and
captured compatibility pass, but one generated test indexes the wrong envelope
field. Harness stops with needs_revision and rejects incomplete handoff; failed
resume makes no new model call. The final-review call is unused and the campaign
is closed. A disposable one-line diagnostic passes 4 supplemental and 4 protected
checks, without qualifying the original journey. Task 8 stays open. See
docs/plan-build-fresh-journey-results.md; bounded repair/resume is the next
qualification opportunity. That local correction is now qualified by 351 source
and 351 installed checks, 3/3 guard-removal detections and an installed failure/
repair/retest replay. The original native failure remains unchanged. A two-call
native guided repair/final review is prepared separately and awaits allocation;
Task 8 stays open. See docs/plan-build-repair-resume-results.md. Patrick approved
that trial with “a/approve”; its Luna process failed during local Codex startup
because the outer sandbox blocked local state writes. No model reply or usage
was received. The unresolved attempt is retained and allocation closed. A
no-model host-access startup check passes. The proposed replacement retains the
20-credit total planning allowance with 2 reserved for the unresolved attempt;
explicit retry approval is pending. See docs/plan-build-repair-native-results.md.
Patrick then approved “A/approve.” The replacement call returns the same faulty
test unchanged, using 0.179815 estimated credits. No file effect or reviewer call
occurs; the allocation closes. Rejected-reply inspection and the experimental
repair objective are corrected and locally qualified (362 source, 362 installed,
3/3 guard removals). The original native failure remains failed. The clarified
two-call case was then superseded by Patrick's direction to prepare a matched
Luna/Sol/Astra comparison. The three-case, two-repetition worker screen is locally
qualified (78 source, 78 installed checks; 3/3 guard removals), with zero new paid
calls. Its 18-call proposal estimates 65–135 new credits, with a separate 150-credit
planning ceiling awaiting approval. Task 8 is open. See
docs/plan-build-repair-feedback-results.md and
docs/plan-build-repair-model-preparation.md.
Patrick subsequently approved the 18-call allocation with “a/approve.” All 18
original repairs pass: six each for Luna, Sol and Astra, with actual tests,
semantic preservation, no-repeat continuation and stale-source rejection. The
allocation closes at 79.574004 estimated credits against the separate 150-credit
planning ceiling, with no retries or new API dollars. Luna is the provisional
next-trial candidate on cost. Native final review and complete connected handoff
remain unqualified; Task 8 remains open. See docs/plan-build-repair-model-results.md.
Patrick requested more evidence with only Luna and Sol competing and Astra
grading in-session. The expanded nine-case, three-attempt preparation qualifies
nine full reference repairs, rejects six partial repairs and rehearses all 54
slots without model calls. Its new allocation is proposed at 90–180 worker
credits with a 200-credit planning ceiling, excluding ordinary session review
usage. Concrete spend approval was pending at preparation; prior results stay unchanged. See
docs/plan-build-repair-contenders-preparation.md.
Patrick approved the allocation with “run.” All 54 original calls completed:
Sol 27/27, Luna 23/27, 90.296895 estimated worker credits, no retries and zero
new API dollars. The allocation is closed. The separate eight-call pilot passes
4/4 per model at 7.158747 credits, with no quality gain from its import filter;
it is also closed. Closeout verifies 13,678 earlier receipt files and all 276
retained pilot files unchanged. Sol replaces Luna as the candidate for the next
connected native repair/retest/resume qualification. Native final review and
complete connected handoff remain unqualified; Task 8 is still open. See
docs/plan-build-repair-contenders-results.md and
docs/plan-build-routing-filter-opportunities.md.
Patrick next selected the narrow Luna eligibility experiment with “run.” Eight
new matched cases and two attempts per worker give 32 proposed calls. Local
qualification passes; no provider calls ran. The new estimate is 50–105 worker
credits with a 120-credit planning ceiling, pending the existing amount-specific
decision. Task 8 stays open. See docs/plan-build-routing-eligibility-preparation.md.
Patrick subsequently approved the current 32-call pilot with “go.” Admission and
the no-model startup check pass. All 32 originals are now complete: Luna 16/16,
Sol 15/16, frozen policy 15/16. The policy saves 46.4% versus always-Sol but fails
its perfect-pass continuation floor on one malformed Sol reply. The separate
allocation closes at 35.370918 estimated worker credits, with no retries or new
API dollars. No production route or broader follow-up is qualified/allocated.
Task 8 remains open. See docs/plan-build-routing-eligibility-results.md.
Patrick then approved broader Luna validation with “ok” and “go” after the
40-call / 10–20-credit estimate / 30-credit planning ceiling. Twenty seeded
real-module repairs across twelve modules and two attempts each are locally
qualified and frozen. The Luna-only trial stopped and closed after 21 calls;
ordinary session grading is excluded, no new API dollars or retries are included,
and no production route or Task 8 acceptance follows automatically. See
docs/specs/plan-build/luna-broader-experiment.md and decisions.md D36.
Closeout: 12 original passes, 9 failures, 7.043789 worker credits, 19 unused slots.
Reference-source leakage in two passing cases invalidates clean qualification;
all original grades remain intact. See docs/plan-build-luna-broader-results.md
and D38. D37's separate zero-model body-only replay is complete and verified:
unrelated renderer bytes preserved; replay-only checks reject the within-function
logic failure; 17,216 prior receipts and all original grades unchanged. See
docs/plan-build-function-body-replay-results.md and D39.
Auto-run of remaining non-high local work
is authorized; further paid/native calls require another allocation.
